model_revision: Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 served by vLLM (self-hosted, SSH-tunneled to 127.0.0.1:18000)

usage_notes: Operator deployment contract: base_url http://127.0.0.1:18000/v1, model qwen3.8-27b-fp8, and a non-empty dummy api_key are stable values across backend machine swaps; /v1/chat/completions (SSE + tools), /v1/models, /v1/completions are served.
Self-hosted local runtime behind an SSH tunnel: availability depends on the tunnel and the remote GPU server; server catalog reports max_model_len 131072 and owned_by vllm.

Reasoning is exposed in the nonstandard message.reasoning field (not reasoning_content); consumers parsing reasoning_content must adapt. Tool calls use finish_reason=tool_calls with the standard OpenAI tools format.

Deployment guidance: max_tokens >= 1024 for thinking output to reach content; concurrency cap 4 concurrent generations with queueing (no errors), long documents (>100K prompt) advised to limit to 2 concurrent; timeouts 60-120s per request class (gateway uses 300s like other routes per operator direction).
